derived_kpi_strategies.note: Average client funds is the arithmetic mean of exact opening and ending reported balances.

normalization_notes: Revenue per client is derived from disclosed recurring revenue divided by approximate disclosed client count for FY2023-FY2025.

Average client employees are pinned as issuer lower-bound disclosures for FY2023-FY2025 (over 140, over 150, and over 150 respectively); the FY2025 control value remains 150 and retains the lower-bound limitation.
FY2026 opening operational-driver seeds are governed by the exact accepted HistoricalFoundation and are not synthesized inside the SourceBundle corpus.
